entities.summary: Tang, a notable figure in the history of North Korea, associated with Goguryeo Kingdom (598–668). Preceded by Goguryeo-Sui/Tang Wars and Fall and Gwanggaeto. Their legacy influenced Tang-Silla alliance conquers Goguryeo after prolonged resistance.
